accepted: נַחֲמוּ עַמִּי דַּבְּרוּ עַל־לִבּוֹ וְקִרְאוּ אֵלָיו כִּי מָלְאָה צְבָאוֹ

source.citation: Davidson, An Introductory Hebrew Grammar (22nd ed., 1923), exercise §43 B 1; McFadyen, Key to the Exercises (1924)

items.stimulus: וַיֶּחֱלֶא הַמֶּלֶךְ בְּרַגְלָיו וְגַם־בְּחָלְיוֹ לֹא דָרַשׁ אֶת־יהוה
options: And the king was diseased in his feet, yet in his disease he sought not Yahweh.
And there was strife between the herdsmen of Abram's cattle and the herdsmen of Lot's cattle; and they said to one another, Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee.

And the watchers saw a man coming out of the city, and they said to him, Show us, we pray thee, the entrance to the city, and we will deal with thee kindly. And he showed them the entrance to the city, and they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but the man they let go. And the man went to the land of the Hittites; and he built a city, and called the name of it Luz; that is its name to this day.
And Noah planted a vineyard, and he drank of the wine and was drunken; and he uncovered himself within his tent.
items.answer: And the king was diseased in his feet, yet in his disease he sought not Yahweh.

source.citation: Davidson, An Introductory Hebrew Grammar (22nd ed., 1923), exercise §45a A 5; McFadyen, Key to the Exercises (1924)

items.stimulus: וְנִבְחַר מָוֶת מֵחַיִּים לְכֹל הַנִּשְׁאָרִים מִן־הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת
options: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all that are left of this evil family.
Yahweh loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwelling-places of Jacob.
Behold, obedience is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.
Take away my life, for I am not better than my fathers.
items.answer: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all that are left of this evil family.

source.citation: Davidson, An Introductory Hebrew Grammar (22nd ed., 1923), exercise §47 A 9; McFadyen, Key to the Exercises (1924)
